```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(rpart)       
library(rpart.plot)  
library(class)       
library(kernlab)     
library(corrplot) 
library(caret) 
library(randomForest)
library(e1071)
```

```{r}
# Setting seed for reproducibility
set.seed(741152)  

# Reading the dataset from the specified path
seeds_data <- read.table("C:/Users/bless/Desktop/CW Statistical Modelling & Data Mining/seeds_dataset.txt", header = FALSE)

# Checking the dimensions of the dataset
dim(seeds_data)

# Defining column names for better understanding
column_names <- c("Area", "Perimeter", "Compactness", "Length", "Width", "Asymmetry_Coefficient", "Length_Kernel_Groove", "Variety")

# Renaming the columns to more descriptive names
colnames(seeds_data) <- column_names

# Summarizing the dataset to get an overview of its contents
summary(seeds_data)

# Displaying the structure of the dataset
str(seeds_data)

```
```{r}
# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(seeds_data))
sum(is.null(seeds_data))

# Check for duplicate values and remove duplicates
duplicated_rows <- seeds_data[duplicated(seeds_data), ]
seeds_data <- unique(seeds_data)

# Remove rows with missing values
seeds_data <- na.omit(seeds_data)

```

```{r}

# Count occurrences of each class in 'Variety'
class_counts <- table(seeds_data$Variety)

# Create a colorful bar chart
barplot(class_counts, col = c("#FFB6C1", "#ADD8E6", "#90EE90"),
        main = "Class Distribution", xlab = "Variety", ylab = "Frequency")

```

```{r}
# Plot histograms for numeric variables
par(mfrow = c(2, 4))  # Setting up a grid for subplots

for (i in 1:ncol(seeds_data)) {
  if (is.numeric(seeds_data[[i]])) {
    hist(seeds_data[[i]], main = paste("Histogram of", names(seeds_data)[i]), xlab = names(seeds_data)[i])
  }
}

```

```{r}
# Compute the correlation matrix
correlation_matrix <- cor(seeds_data)

# Create a correlation plot using corrplot
corrplot(correlation_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", order = "hclust", tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45)

```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 4))
# Boxplot to identify outliers for a specific variable
for (i in column_names) {
  boxplot(seeds_data[[i]], main = paste("Boxplot of", i))
}

```


```{r}
# Recursive feature selection (RFE)

ctrl <- rfeControl(functions = rfFuncs, method = "cv", number = 5)
suppressWarnings(rfProfile <- rfe(seeds_data[, 1:(ncol(seeds_data) - 1)], seeds_data$Variety, sizes = c(1:(ncol(seeds_data) - 1)), rfeControl = ctrl))


print(rfProfile$optVariables)

seeds_data_Re <- seeds_data[, c(rfProfile$optVariables,"Variety")]
summary(seeds_data_Re)

```

```{r}

# Split data into training and testing sets
train_index <- seeds_data_Re$Variety %>%  createDataPartition(p = 0.8, list = FALSE)


train_data <- seeds_data_Re[train_index, ]
test_data <- seeds_data_Re[-train_index, ]

# Display class distribution in training and testing sets
table(train_data$Variety)
table(test_data$Variety)

# Feature scaling
train_data[, -ncol(train_data)] <- scale(train_data[, -ncol(train_data)])
test_data[, -ncol(test_data)] <- scale(test_data[, -ncol(test_data)])

# Convert target variable to factor
test_data$Variety <- as.factor(test_data$Variety)
train_data$Variety <- as.factor(train_data$Variety)

```

```{r}
# Model training and evaluation

# k-Nearest Neighbors (kNN) model and create confusion matrix
knn_model <- knn(train = train_data[, -ncol(train_data)], 
                 test = test_data[, -ncol(test_data)], 
                 cl = train_data$Variety, k = 7)
knn_cm <- confusionMatrix(knn_model, test_data$Variety)
print("k-Nearest Neighbors (kNN) model")
print(knn_cm)

```

```{r}
# Random forest (RF) model
rf_model <- randomForest(Variety ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 500)
rf_predict <- predict(rf_model, test_data)
rf_cm <- confusionMatrix(rf_predict, test_data$Variety)
print("Random forest (RF) model")
print(rf_cm)

```

```{r}
# Support vector machine (SVM) model
svm_model <- ksvm(Variety ~ ., data = train_data, 
                  type = "C-svc", kernel = "rbfdot", 
                  kpar = list(sigma = 0.1), C = 100)
svm_predict <- predict(svm_model, test_data)
svm_cm <- confusionMatrix(svm_predict, test_data$Variety)
print("Support vector machine (SVM) model")
print(svm_cm)



```

```{r}
# Decision tree model
seed_tree <- rpart(Variety ~ ., data = train_data, method = "class")

# Plot the decision tree
rpart.plot(seed_tree)

# Make predictions on test data
predictions <- predict(seed_tree, test_data, type = "class")

# Evaluate the accuracy of the model
actual_labels <- test_data$Variety

dt_cm <- confusionMatrix(predictions,actual_labels)

print("Decision tree model")
print(dt_cm)

```

```{r}
# Naive Bayes model
nb_model <- naiveBayes(Variety ~ ., data = train_data)

# Make predictions on test data
predictions <- predict(nb_model, test_data[, -ncol(test_data)])

# Create confusion matrix
nb_cm <- confusionMatrix(predictions,test_data$Variety)

print("Decision tree model")
print(nb_cm)
```

```{r}
model_names <- c("kNN", "RF", "SVM", "DT", "NB") 
accuracy_values <- c(0.881, 0.9048, 0.9524, 0.9286, 0.9286)  

accuracy_data <- data.frame(Model = model_names, Accuracy = accuracy_values)

accuracy_data$Percentage <- paste0(format(accuracy_data$Accuracy * 100, digits = 4), "%")

# Plotting using ggplot2
ggplot(accuracy_data, aes(x = Model, y = Accuracy, fill = Model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Percentage), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(title = "Model Accuracy Comparison",
       x = "Models",
       y = "Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))  


```
